methodology: Figures are independently scoped. BKPM investment realization differs from announced project capital and from PNBP. Values use original currencies and units. Financial facilities are separately listed from equity investment and project budgets. Booking-origin jurisdictions for FDI are not ultimate owners.

regional.note: Only Q2 2026. Geographical realization totals are not individual project asset valuations.

projects.name: Integrated EV battery ecosystem
projects.investor: ANTAM · IBC · Ningbo Contemporary Brunp Lygend (CBL)
projects.region: Karawang, West Java; East Halmahera, North Maluku (multi-site)
projects.amount_basis: Announced integrated ecosystem project investment; not verified realized capex
projects.status_note: Groundbreaking of the six-subproject integrated ecosystem confirmed 29 June 2025. This is a consortium-wide figure, not single-factory spending.
projects.next_step: Track construction, plant commissioning, battery production and offtake

projects.name: Microsoft Indonesia cloud and AI program
projects.amount_basis: Public investment commitment, not confirmed expenditure or AI-only data center capex
projects.status_note: Microsoft announced a four-year program in April 2024; Komdigi reaffirmed commitment September 2026. Value includes cloud/AI infrastructure and skilling, not verified data-center construction spending.
projects.next_step: Track commercial milestones, infrastructure expenditure and workforce programs

projects.name: 13 strategic downstream projects — Phase II
projects.amount_basis: Combined announced project investment for 13 projects, not realized expenditure
projects.status_note: BKPM announced collective groundbreaking; individual company allocations not disclosed in this source
projects.next_step: Track individual SPVs, contractor awards, drawdowns and COD

projects.name: IGP Pomalaa — mine and HPAL
projects.investor: PT Vale Indonesia · PT Kolaka Nickel Indonesia · Huayou · Ford (project partners)
projects.amount_basis: Company-described full project investment (mine and HPAL); not verified realized cash outlay, not limited to KNI equity
projects.status_note: PT Vale disclosed 62% overall project progress in February 2026; ore-sales milestone in March 2026 should not be conflated with HPAL operation.
projects.next_step: Track HPAL mechanical completion, actual commissioning and current cap table of KNI.

projects.name: IGP Morowali — mine and HPAL / BNSI
projects.investor: PT Vale Indonesia · PT Bahodopi Nickel Smelting Indonesia (BNSI) · GEM · EcoPro
projects.amount_basis: Integrated IGP Morowali project investment estimate (mine and HPAL), not disbursed capital
projects.status_note: Vale reported July 2026 arrival of HPAL autoclave; mining ore first sales occurred 2025, but HPAL facility construction continued.
projects.next_step: Track equipment installation, 2027 expected HPAL project completion and venture ownership.

projects.name: PTFI Manyar copper smelter
projects.investor: PT Freeport Indonesia (PTFI); shareholder groups MIND ID / PT IPMM / FCX
projects.amount_basis: Not included: no single current realized-capex figure verified in this source
projects.status_note: FCX reports May 2025 startup and July 2025 first cathode; 2025 production and post-September 2025 concentrate constraints mean operational status does not equal full utilization.
projects.next_step: Monitor Q4 2026 feed availability, concentrate shipments and actual utilization rather than design capacity.

limitations: Minerals and coal PNBP are combined in the cited release; do not assert a separate coal or critical-minerals amount.
No verified standalone national PNBP series for AI/data center revenue in selected sources.
Project values represent announced amounts, not verified spent capital.
The Q2 provincial figures are not cumulative H1 figures.

Overlapping multi-project programs (including the 13-project Phase II bundle, Vale IGP campuses and the ANTAM-IBC-CBL ecosystem) cannot be added to national BKPM realization or one another without project-level reconciliation.
For assets with known JV partners, no share percentages are imputed unless disclosed in company filings.

foreign_origins.metric: PMA realized; booking jurisdiction is not investor ultimate nationality
foreign_origins.note: Hong Kong is a booking origin and must not be equated with the final nationality or beneficial owner. Remaining origin values are not published in the cited release.

financing.classification: Signed financing facility, not proof of amount drawn nor additional project capex
financing.project_relation: Corporate sustainability-linked facility; do not automatically allocate across Pomalaa and Morowali projects
